note: Ratchet v2 live-fires as designed on gala night: check --changed exits 1 on 7 NEW hits from sibling lanes' changed files, the seal lane b2 just wired into pre-push exits 1 on 3 drifted configs (including providers.yaml, an untracked live-creds file git can no longer see, so only the seal catches it), freshness exits 0 on 2026-09-25 frozen registrations; estate grep: 4 ratchet files in corpus/steal/, 'exit 2' covered in corpus/steal/ (4 hits) but ZERO hits in memory/corpus/ (first-class negative); all 5 mined quotes byte-verified literal in a12-ratchet-v2.check.txt section 4.

rows.law: exit 2 is the only hard block
rows.claim: The ratchet names three exits and only exit 2 means the gate itself is broken; in changed mode a git failure refuses to guess the changed set rather than pass or fake a failure.
rows.quote: Exit codes: 0 = pass (no new violations), 1 = new violations found, 2 = gate itself broken.
rows.steal: Treat exit 2 as distinguishable testimony in every GALA check: a gate that cannot run must exit 2, never 0; tonight's ratchet exit 1 is NEW-debt evidence from sibling lanes, not a broken gate, and gets recorded not muted.
rows.falsifier: Break git for the tool and rerun check --changed: output must be the refuse-to-guess line with exit 2; a 0 or 1 there falsifies the three-exit contract.

rows.law: register debt by name or fix it
rows.claim: The baseline register only grows through a named human/agent act carrying --by and --note, and only shrinks via prune; no command may refresh it as a side effect.
rows.quote:
The register grows only via `baseline-update` (a named human/agent act with `--by`/`--note`),
shrinks via `prune` (fixed debt leaves).
rows.steal: Attribute tonight's 7 NEW hits to owner lanes at close-out (mag: intervention_gate.py, skill_lifecycle.py twice; tools: mcp_pin.py, quote_audit_wide.py twice, wandr_selfeval.py) and let each owner run baseline-update --by <lane> with a note.
rows.falsifier: Grep configs/violation_baseline.json accepted entries for one missing 'by' or 'accepted' date: a single anonymous claim falsifies the by-name law.

rows.claim: Accepted debt is not forever: once the bytes are fixed, prune deletes the dead claim, so the register trends down and partial fixes stay visible without double punishment.
rows.quote:
Not auto-fixable: a silent pass is sometimes a decision; each needs eyes
(`prune` recovers the claim on fix).
rows.steal: End every except-pass fix lap with prune plus a before/after register count filed in the receipt; ghost.py's 70 sites (the WAVE2 fix queue) are the standing first target.
rows.falsifier: Fix one registered violation and run prune: the register must drop by exactly that fingerprint; a no-op prune after a verified fix falsifies the recovery law.

rows.claim: The seal's PASS condition is sha256 equality between live config bytes and the register, so verification collapses to compute: no model, however smart, can talk drifted bytes past a hash.
rows.quote: CONFIG-SEAL: PASS — every config byte matches the register.
rows.steal: Keep lane b2's seal verify in the pre-push hook untouched; when the drift re-seals at close-out, cite the new register hashes by name so the receipt is itself hash-checkable.
rows.falsifier: Flip one byte in configs/mag.yaml and rerun verify: it must exit 1 naming the file; a PASS on flipped bytes falsifies the seal.

rows.law: freshness gate is the stale-trap vaccine
rows.claim: The meter states its bar in numbers before reading anything (stale at 7 days while repo heartbeat is 2 days) and offers exactly two remedies: refresh with today's truth or register frozen with reason plus date.
rows.quote:
Exit 1 when any doc is stale — the fix is to
refresh the doc (with today's truth) or re-register it as deliberately frozen by
adding it to FROZEN_OK below with a reason and date.
rows.steal: Apply to any gala doc older than 7 days: refresh it or FROZEN_OK it by name; tonight's PASS holds only because BOOT_4_7.md and state/HANDOFF.md carry 2026-09-25 frozen registrations.
rows.falsifier: Delete the FROZEN_OK entries while BOOT_4_7.md stays 11.8d old: the next run must FAIL with exit 1; a PASS there falsifies the vaccine.

decision_changed: 3 drifted configs: lanes.yaml and mag.yaml are tonight's own lane edits (uncommitted working tree) and get re-sealed at gala close-out by the lane that owns them, name + note citing this lane's receipt; providers.yaml is NOT re-sealed by a12: it is an untracked live-creds file (gitignored since 5a6ffd806) whose drift only the seal can see, so the operator must first attest what changed (rotation or edit) and re-seal under their own name; until then the seal FAIL stays live as testimony, matching the WAVE2 precedent of leaving unregistered debt so the push meets the gate.
